answer.rationale: Memory 57 most directly supports sustainable qualified revenue because it reports qualified revenue gains and no measurable retention harm. Memory 44 links sales-assisted conversion to pipeline quality, but omits realized revenue and long-term retention. Memory 73 shows acquisition and revenue lift in the threatened segment, but omits margins, retention, qualification, and durability under promotional pricing. Memories 31 and 86 establish durable activation or improved onboarding and adoption, but do not connect those gains to qualified revenue or retention. Memory 91 is weakest because it reports only short-term engagement and first-action movement, with no evidence of durability, revenue quality, or downstream commercial impact.
